title: Jelly changing the family name to Lamar
summary: She says his name was Lamothe and he altered it close to Mouton to sound northern.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: How come that the—Gellarrow changed—he evidently took that name then. He took it—he named it—
His name was Lamar. See, but he took the name because he wanted to be right along with us. My mother wanted it that way, though. Mm-hmm.
But then he put the R in there, changed the spelling, huh? Yeah, he changed it— Somebody did. To Americanize the name.

Yeah. He just didn't want to be from the South. That's all. He wanted to be like Benny Morkman and these other people up there. He changed it himself. He changed it because it was so near like Mouton. He just put the R instead of using the U, see? Yeah. He just changed the one letter. That's right. One letter, that's all.
Well, I had never known that until I found out from here then.
